title.en: Unit 1203 S2 Ep.10 — Day 8: Medicine in the Go Bag

_note: 11/18. 인스타 스킬 점검 뒤 첫 화. 훅을 구체물(가방 속 약) + 뒤집기(상비약만으론 부족)로, 끝을 '빠진 건 몇 번? 댓글에 번호' 퀴즈로. 화면 표현은 '재난가방'. 구조는 9화(실수 먼저 → 세 가지, 세 번째를 뒤로 → 떡밥 → 카드 한 컷). 한국어 음성은 silenceremove 후 배속 1.3.

beats.en: Did you pack only antacids and band-aids in your go bag?
beats.prompt: Top-down close view of an open small gray backpack lying on a wooden street bench in daylight: inside and beside it only a few things, one small plain medicine box, one strip of adhesive bandages, one water bottle and a folded scarf, two stick-figure hands in dark blue padded jacket sleeves holding the bag open, the inside of the bag looks mostly empty. Same simple thick black line doodle drawing style as the reference, drawn quietly and seriously: muted palette (slate gray, dark blue, dark brick red, muted ochre), overcast gray daylight with clear visibility, soft shadows, no comic symbols, cinematic vertical composition, every package and label completely blank, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark

But the pharmacy shutter was down.
